Name: Meshech, Son of Shem
Summary: Son of Shem, named among the sons of Shem in the table of nations.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 1:17: Son of Shem, named among the sons of Shem in the table of nations.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Meshech stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
